pages.title: The work
pages.text:
**Assignment list:** chapter **Strand: Spindle**.

A digital loom (AE2 — a Knot in the controller, a Braid in the assembler). A Gate Drum. The March, and a March stone from it.

Nine seated, one stone, one right-click on the Post: the Fragment. **Seat the Fragment.** The cut closes above your pad. That is the end of the Ninjacat Skies storyline.

pages.title: Reweave
pages.text: The Loom-stitchers cut the gate-paths and always meant to come back and mend them. They did not get to. You will.
